# Planview AgilePlace - product overview (Avantra summary)

> Demonstration content summarised by Avantra from publicly available Planview positioning. Pending curator verification against the official product page and datasheet. Contains no pricing.

## Overview

Visual Kanban-based work management for agile teams and teams-of-teams, connecting team-level delivery to planning.

Also known as: AgilePlace, LeanKit. Solution areas: Enterprise Agile Planning, Digital Product Development. Deployment: SaaS.

## Capabilities

- **Kanban / visual boards** - a core capability of Planview AgilePlace: Visual boards for flow-based work management with WIP limits.
- **Agile planning at scale** - a core capability of Planview AgilePlace: Plan and coordinate agile teams and teams-of-teams; connect agile delivery to portfolio.
- **Collaborative work management** - a supported capability of Planview AgilePlace: Team collaboration on tasks, documents and plans.
- **OKR management** - a supported capability of Planview AgilePlace: Define and track objectives and key results linked to work. Note: OKR support to be verified by curator.
- **Reporting & analytics** - a supported capability of Planview AgilePlace: Dashboards and analytics across portfolios and work.
- **Toolchain integration** - available via integration of Planview AgilePlace: Synchronise work items across delivery tools (e.g. Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow). Note: Integration with developer tools via Planview Hub or connectors.

## Implementation considerations

- Define board standards (lanes, card types, WIP limits) centrally to keep teams-of-teams reporting consistent.
- Decide the system of record per team (AgilePlace vs. Jira/Azure DevOps) before integrating.
